evidence.evidence_text: Recently, training-based TTS methods, such as continued reinforcement learning (RL), have further surged in popularity, while training-free TTS methods are gradually fading from prominence.
We first design Conditional Step-level Self-refinement, a fine-grained sequential scaling method guided by process verification.
On top of its effectiveness, we further combine it with other classical parallel scaling methods at the step level, to introduce a novel inference paradigm called Hybrid Test-Time Scaling.
